messages:
anya: +1 from support — customer 'Clipkar' seeing recurring 504s on /v1/generate hosted API starting ~2024-02-20T16:02Z. Support traces show p95/99 tail timeouts at gateway, continuous-batching backlog and queue depth saturating. sample req id: req-cc-72f4. Raising incident.

support-bot: Incident created #INC-2024-128, paging oncall.

kyle: joining. what's the reproduction? any client patterns? long context? spikes?

dana: support attached logs — key lines below:
```
[16:02:11] batcher: EnqueueBackpressure tenant=clipkar pending=312 max_pending=300
[16:02:12] gateway: request=req-cc-72f4 status=504 reason=tail_timeout queue_ms=12050
[16:02:13] batcher: DequeueLatency p95=8750ms p99=24500ms
```

rafa: sounds like continuous-batching backlog + kvcache misses — requests sit waiting for full batch and hit gateway deadline. Are they issuing a flood of small concurrent requests?

anya: customer says ~350 concurrent workers hitting API, avg seq ~512. They retried aggressively on client errors which amplified the spike.

kyle: mitigation plan: lower CONT_BATCH_MAX_PENDING for affected batch pool and enable early-reject to shed excess load. I'll push a hotfix: set CONT_BATCH_MAX_PENDING=200 and REJECT_ON_HEAVY_LOAD=true for pool clipkar.

dana: also plan to enable fallback routing to 'redwood-medium-quant' for this tenant during peak — reduces per-token time and short-circuits heavy batches.

kyle: deploying canary to us-west-2-batcher-3 (10%) now.

support-bot: deploy started by kyle at 2024-02-20T16:25Z

rafa: repro for SRE/devex:
```
for i in {1..400}; do
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
    -d '{\"input\": \"A long prompt... (repeat) \", \"max_tokens\":512}' &
done
wait
```
This reproduces enqueue backlog quickly.

kyle: canary shows p95 drop 10s -> 1.2s, 504s eliminated for canary traffic. Promoting to remainder of cluster.

anya: support to customer: "We've applied temporary load-shedding and a thinner model fallback while we tune batching and recommend clients add jittered backoff. We'll follow up with a more permanent config and a post-incident summary."

dana: action items:
- Add auto-shed policy: if pending > 200 for 30s, reject earliest incoming small requests.
- Update continuous-batcher runbook with step-by-step hotfixes and safe defaults.
- Add alert: batcher.pending > 250 for 1m -> page SRE.
- Outreach: customer guidance on retry/backoff and common pitfalls.

rafa: logging improvement: add tenant tag to EnqueueBackpressure and surface in console charts.

kyle: final check: clipkar metrics stable for 8m, p95 ~1.1s, 504s no longer reported. Will monitor 30m then close.

anya: thanks all — keeping incident open till close.
